title.narrative: Zanzibar Malaria Elimination Program - Zanzibar (01-Oct-2015-31-Dec-2017)

description.narrative: Zanzibar, Malaria, Ministry of Health of the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar (Ministry of Health, Zanzibar)This program has the following goals: To consolidate malaria control achievements towards pre-elimination by 2018 (Mid Term Goal). To eliminate malaria in Zanzibar (Long Term Goal). The objectives of this program are: Objective 1: Increase confirmatory test to suspected Malaria cases using the recommended parasitological test by 100 % in year 2015. Objective 2: Improve the treatment of confirmatory malaria cases by adding an anti â€“gametocidal drug from 0% in 2013 to 100% by 2017. Objective 3: Develop systems to maintain universal coverage (100%) prevention measures by 2018. Objective 4: Expand malaria surveillance to actively detect cases and investigate confirmed malaria cases to 100% by year 2018. Objective 5: Develop functional coordination structures for malaria elimination at 3 operational levels (National, district and Shehia) by 2018. Objective 6: Increase provision of correct knowledge and good practice towards eliminating malaria in the Zanzibar population by 90% in 2018. Objective 7: Increase provision of correct knowledge and good practice towards eliminating malaria in the Zanzibar population by 90% in 2018

title.narrative: Impact indicators targets and results for QNB-M-MoHP01
Malaria parasite prevalence: Proportion of children aged 6-59 months with malaria infection
Malaria test positivity rate
Malaria I-Other 1: Number of malaria deaths among all ages (both audited and un-audited)
Confirmed malaria cases (microscopy or RDT): rate per 1000 persons per year
Reported malaria cases (presumed and confirmed)
Outcome indicators targets and results for QNB-M-MoHP01
Proportion of households with at least one insecticide-treated net for every two people and/or sprayed by IRS within the last 12 months
Proportion of population with access to an ITN within their household
Proportion of population that slept under an insecticide-treated net the previous night
Proportion of malaria cases (presumed and confirmed) that received first line antimalarial treatment at private sector sites
Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for QNB-M-MoHP01
PM-Other 1: Number of produced technical reports by technical/thematic working groups for programatic decision making.
Percentage of health facilities reporting no stock-outs of essential drugs
PM-Other 2: Number of programme reviews conducted to improve programatic perfomance
Proportion of health facilities without stock-outs of key commodities during the reporting period
PSM-Other 1: Percentage of product batches tested at central store in the past year that met national and international quality control standards
Number of long-lasting insecticidal nets distributed to at-risk populations through mass campaigns
Proportion of suspected malaria cases that receive a parasitological test in the community
Proportion of population at risk potentially covered by long lasting insecticidal nets distributed
Proportion of confirmed malaria cases that received first-line antimalarial treatment at public sector health facilities
Proportion of suspected malaria cases that receive a parasitological test at public sector health facilities
Proportion of facility reports received over the reports expected during the reporting period
Percentage of confirmed cases fully investigated and classified
Proportion of confirmed malaria cases that received first-line antimalarial treatment at private sector sites
Proportion of suspected malaria cases that receive a parasitological test at private sector sites
Percentage of HMIS or other routine reporting units submitting timely reports according to national guidelines
Proportion of population protected by IRS within the last 12 months in areas targeted for IRS
Proportion of households in targeted areas that received Indoor Residual Spraying during the reporting period
